name: idea-config
description: Read, diagnose and hand-edit a JetBrains project's .idea/ directory for any IntelliJ-platform IDE (PhpStorm, GoLand, PyCharm, IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm and the rest): VCS root mappings for nested repos, module content and source roots with package prefixes, excludes, run configurations, debugger servers and path mappings, interpreters and SDKs. scripts/idea-config.sh runs a read-only doctor (stale paths, unmapped nested git repos, dead mappings, duplicate entries, invalid XML, a running IDE that would overwrite disk edits) and backs .idea up before an edit. References cite a tiered corpus of JetBrains docs and intellij-community source.
